gold.user: Alice wants to retrieve the current navigation views in her Zulip application to understand how users are interacting with the interface.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of navigation views that are currently set up in the Zulip application, including their identifiers and configurations.

gold.user: Bob is a developer who needs to add a new navigation view for a feature he is working on. He prepares the necessary data and sends a request to create the view.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the new navigation view data and return a confirmation of the addition, including the unique identifier for the new view.

gold.user: Charlie realizes that the existing navigation view needs some adjustments to improve user experience. He sends a request to update the view with new settings.
gold.ideal: The API should update the specified navigation view with the new settings and return the updated view details to confirm the changes.

gold.user: Dana has decided that a particular navigation view is no longer necessary and wants to remove it from the system to declutter the interface.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified navigation view and return a success message indicating that the view has been removed.
